overview: This enum labels the kind of prize attached to a PvP rank reward row.

None.technical: FGameDataTableRow_RankSystemReward defaults RewardType to None. No traced C++ branch reads RewardType. No exported row uses this value.

Money.technical: Declared as Money. The shipped RankSystemRewardDataTable pairs every Money row with an item set whose first item has EGameItemType::Money. No traced C++ branch reads RewardType. The grant and UI paths use Id_ItemSet and the first item row ItemType.

Costume.technical: Declared as Costume. The shipped RankSystemRewardDataTable pairs every Costume row with an item set whose first item has EGameItemType::Costume. No traced C++ branch reads RewardType. The grant and UI paths use Id_ItemSet and the first item row ItemType.

Nickname.technical: Declared as Nickname. The shipped RankSystemRewardDataTable pairs every Nickname row with an item set whose first item has EGameItemType::Nickname. No traced C++ branch reads RewardType. The grant and UI paths use Id_ItemSet and the first item row ItemType.

Plate.simple: The reward is a player card plate.
Plate.technical: Declared as Plate. The shipped RankSystemRewardDataTable pairs every Plate row with an item set whose first item has EGameItemType::Plate. No traced C++ branch reads RewardType. The grant and UI paths use Id_ItemSet and the first item row ItemType.

SituationOverviewPose.simple: The reward is a situation overview pose.
SituationOverviewPose.technical: Declared as SituationOverviewPose. The shipped RankSystemRewardDataTable pairs every SituationOverviewPose row with an item set whose first item has EGameItemType::SituationOverviewPose. No traced C++ branch reads RewardType. The grant and UI paths use Id_ItemSet and the first item row ItemType.

Invalid.simple: This value is a reserved invalid marker.
Invalid.technical: Declared as the uint8 slot 255 in the enum header. No traced C++ branch reads RewardType. No exported row uses this value.

notes: The shipped RankSystemRewardDataTable has 140 rows. Its RewardType values match the EGameItemType of the first item in each row Id_ItemSet.

GameShop_GrantRankSystemRewards selects rows by RequiredPoint, received history, and unlock state, then grants Id_ItemSet. The reward UI reads the first Item row ItemType for its name, preview, decision button, and category icon.
No traced C++ consumer branches on RewardType. Blueprint reads remain outside the static source evidence used here.
